status -- Report status

USAGE
  status
  status all
  status director[=<director>] [days=<days>] [verbose]
  status client=<client>
  status storage[=<storage>] [slots] [drive=<drive>] [device=<device>]
  status job=<job>
  status jobid=<jobid>
  status ujobid=<ujobid>
  status scheduler[=<schedule>] [client=<client>] [job=<job>] [days=<days>] [schedule=<schedule>]
  status subscriptions [detail] [clients] [plugins] [all] [anonymize] [client=<client>] [unknown]
  status configuration

DESCRIPTION
  Shows the state of the Director, a client, a storage or the scheduler. Without argument the Director asks which daemon.

SUBCOMMANDS
  status all
      Director, every storage and every client
  status director[=<director>]
      Director status
  status client=<client>
      Status of a File Daemon
  status storage[=<storage>]
      Status of a Storage Daemon
  status job=<job>
      Status of the storage of a job
  status jobid=<jobid>
      Status of the storage of a job
  status ujobid=<ujobid>
      Status of the storage of a job
  status scheduler[=<schedule>]
      Jobs the scheduler will start
  status subscriptions
      Subscription and unit counts
  status configuration
      Configuration warnings

ARGUMENTS
  status director[=<director>]
    director[=<director>]
        Director name (text; the value may be left out)
    days=<days>
        Scheduled jobs of the next days (number)
    verbose
        More detail (keyword)
  status client=<client>
    client=<client>
        Client name (name; values from .clients)
  status storage[=<storage>]
    storage[=<storage>]
        Storage name (name; values from .storages; the value may be left out)
    slots
        Autochanger slots (keyword)
    drive=<drive>
        Drive number (number)
    device=<device>
        Device name (text)
  status job=<job>
    job=<job>
        Job name (name; values from .jobs)
  status jobid=<jobid>
    jobid=<jobid>
        Job ID (number)
  status ujobid=<ujobid>
    ujobid=<ujobid>
        Unique job name (text)
  status scheduler[=<schedule>]
    scheduler[=<scheduler>]
        Schedule name (name; values from .schedule; the value may be left out)
    client=<client>
        Jobs of a client (name; values from .clients)
    job=<job>
        One job (name; values from .jobs)
    days=<days>
        Days ahead (number)
    schedule=<schedule>
        Schedule name (name; values from .schedule)
  status subscriptions
    detail
        Details (keyword)
    clients
        Per client (keyword)
    plugins
        Per plugin (keyword)
    all
        Everything (keyword)
    anonymize
        Anonymize names (keyword)
    client=<client>
        One client (name; values from .clients)
    unknown
        Unknown clients (keyword)

ORIGIN
  Bareos console command.
